coordinate_space: Blender / AP-001 metres, +Z up; FBX -Z forward / Y up (Unity bakeAxisConversion); Unity (X,Z) = (x,y)

ground.name: DD/GroundBlend
ground.uv: UVMap = world/4 (or planar world xz in shader)
ground.blend: albedo = R*earth + G*gravel*_GravelTint + B*stone; normal/mask likewise; height-weighted blend optional
ground.wet: albedo *= 1 - 0.45*A; smoothness = lerp(map, 0.60, A) (cap 0.60, DEC-076 no mirror-wet)

water.name: DD/Water v2

flow.note: Gentle clockwise drift seen from above in each pond; flow map RG 512 per pond, zero at the rim.

water.note: Colours sRGB (PondWater). Dark teal-grey plane with a soft overcast-sky sheen; at the -49 deg camera specular stays point-like (1-2 sun glints). Foam is a thin wet scum line, not white crests. rain_rate applies only in a drizzle weather state; 0 when dry.
